source_caption:
🎥🎬: Rolling Loud The Movie (2026)

Owen Wilson stars as an overprotective dad who sneaks his 13-year-old son into the legendary Rolling Loud Miami festival, only to lose him in the middle of the massive crowd. What starts as an unforgettable father-son adventure quickly turns into a chaotic mission through one of the biggest music festivals in the world.

With Matt Rife alongside Owen Wilson and appearances from Travis Scott, Sexyy Red, Ty Dolla $ign, Ski Mask The Slump God and more, Rolling Loud The Movie brings music, comedy, and family chaos to the big screen.

🎬 In theaters October 2, 2026

source_details.synopsis: Rolling Loud: The Movie is a 2026 American comedy film written and directed by Jeremy Garelick. The film stars Owen Wilson, Matt Rife, Christine Ko, Christian Convery, Henry Winkler, and Jolene Blalock alongside musical guests such as Sexyy Red, Ty Dolla Sign, Ski Mask the Slump God, and Travis Scott.
